# Energy Revolution System Guide
> Independent, evidence-first guide to Energy Revolution System, a ~$39 digital DIY home-energy blueprint sold on ClickBank with a 60-day refund.

Key facts:
- Energy Revolution System is a digital DIY energy guide (instructions, diagrams, parts guidance), not a physical generator.
- Named creator: Michael Garnett (per sales materials).
- Price: about $39 one-time; build parts cost extra.
- Guarantee: 60-day money-back via ClickBank.
- Inspired by Tesla's US Patent 512,340 (Coil for Electro-Magnets, Jan 9, 1894); the patent does not prove surplus energy.
- Advertised 70-88% bill savings are unverified.

Main page: https://YOURDOMAIN.com/
